AudioResourceDescriptorWire.description: Frozen audio stream and source-time semantics.

FontResourceDescriptorWire.description: One concrete font face and its supported variable-font axes.

LottieResourceDescriptorWire.description: Frozen Lottie source clock, extent, and boundary-sample semantics.

MotionArtifactDescriptorWire.description:
Motion artifact compositor-read semantics. The artifact's embedded `controls` object is the
only control schema; the manifest does not carry a second digest projection of it.

ResourceEntryWire.description:
Closed resource-kind union. A descriptor from one kind cannot be decoded as
another kind's descriptor.

ShaderResourceDescriptorWire.description: Frozen shader parameter schema and destination-read semantics.

VideoResourceDescriptorWire.description: Frozen video stream and source-time semantics.

TimelineDocumentWire.description: Typed root bands. Array order is retained because it is render-semantic.
